subject: general
question: Which of the following sports was NOT played at the 2020 Summer Olympic Games (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wushu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Olympic Games are held every four years,** alternating between the** Summer and Winter Games every two years in the four-year period.**
 
• The 2020 Summer Olympics commonly known as Tokyo 2020, is to be held in **Tokyo, Japan.**
 
• Hockey, Badminton, and Archery are the summer Olympic sports.
 
• Karate, roller sport, climbing, surfing, baseball, and softball are the recent sports added for **2020**.
 
• Beijing is due to host the **2022 Winter Olympics,** which will make it the first city to host both the Summer and Winter Games.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** 

 
• **Wushu means Martial Technique.**
 
• Wushu Federation was formed in **1990**.
 
• It was first added to the** SEA Games in 1991,** and aside from exclusions in **1995 and 1999 **has not been left off the programme since.
 
• It was one of **eight sports being considered for a single spot in the 2020 Olympics.**
 
• **In May 2013 the IOC decided to drop wushu from the shortlist.**
